parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.stem: Naphtha is a mixture which contains only hydrocarbon molecules.
parts.text: What is meant by the term *hydrocarbon*?

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Name the raw material that is used to produce a sample of naphtha.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem:
Compound **V** is found in naphtha. It has a molecular formula $\text{C}_{10}\text{H}_{22}$.

When **V** is heated at high pressure in the absence of air, an equal number of moles of ethene, propene and **W** are made. **W** is a compound made of straight chain, saturated molecules.
parts.text: Name the process that describes this reaction.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Deduce the structure of **W**. Draw its structure below.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.stem: Propene is separated from the mixture and heated in air in the presence of a catalyst. Propene is oxidised to **X**, which contains two functional groups.
parts.text:
Effervescence is seen when $\text{Na}_2\text{CO}_3\text{(aq)}$ is added to **X**.

Identify the functional group present in **X** which is responsible for this observation.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Identify a reagent which could be used to show that **X** contains a $\text{C=C}$. Include relevant observations.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
**X** reacts with another reagent to form **Y**.

Molecules of **Y** react together to form addition polymer **Z**. The diagram shows the repeat unit of polymer **Z**.

repeat unit of polymer **Z**

{{figure:pdf_visual_01.png}}

Draw the structural formula of monomer **Y**.

parts.label: (e)(i)
parts.stem:
Polymer **Z** is useful because it absorbs large amounts of water. However, there are problems associated with the disposal of products containing polymer **Z**.

Combustion is not an appropriate method to dispose of pure **Z** because the process releases harmful gases. Some of these gases contribute to the enhanced greenhouse effect.
parts.text: Identify a gas released during the combustion of **Z** which contributes to the enhanced greenhouse effect.

parts.label: (e)(ii)
parts.text: Identify another gas which could be produced during the combustion of pure **Z**. Describe a consequence, other than the enhanced greenhouse effect, of its release into the atmosphere.
